name: Daisuke
source:
Calm and silent personality, unusually fast legs, sensitive to smells.
Miku's childhood friend, have a nice relationship since little.
Normally gentle but will show intense anger to things that try harm Miku.
likes milk and cereal
Among those favorite food is canned food, a little unusual boy.
